registry: Twelve separately frozen, reproducible cases drawn from the IANA HTTP status registry. Four ask for a code from memory, four request JSON from a provided row, four request a supplied field with a benign distracting note. Use the identical window harness with the preserved 3.2.1 executable and the release candidate. Never fit the network on these items.
field_extraction: For a literal-only request and a uniquely named key = value assignment outside quoted notes, permit deterministic extraction. Use the local model with source boundaries for other narrowly scoped field requests. On duplicate, ambiguous or missing keys, never pick an arbitrary value from free prose. Test on previously frozen app cases and the separate registry.
kv_materiality: Before the Q8 experiment, define material board-memory savings as at least 256 MiB on this six GiB card under two concurrent clients, without loss on matched diagnostic examples or a throughput loss beyond 5%. Otherwise use the existing 10% throughput criterion without quality loss.
history_controls: In addition to five positive window tests, probe ordinary requests, a different named project, similarly named records, and a record longer than its retrieval budget. Only data from the current chat may be returned. Test controls against the actual production C# methods.
scope: Window fixtures authored for the audit establish app behavior. Published RCB annotations and a separately held-out real private format check carry independent evidence. Published mathematics test questions may have been seen during original Qwen pretraining.
